commands.command: CARGO_INCREMENTAL=0 CARGO_PROFILE_DEV_DEBUG=line-tables-only rtk cargo test --locked -p crucible-search --test reference_search v5_21_01_to_05_sc_dec_038

positive_checks: Frozen reference-search/1 constants, operator/source shares, epoch quota and bounded failed refill accounting are asserted.
Exploration, screen, qualified and adverse/unknown evidence remain separated; durable evidence history retains adverse records and measured descriptors define qualified bins.

Deterministic source fallback, migration interval, protection expiration, CMA-ES/BO bounded inputs, shared grammar cost curves, and charged initialization/inference/audit/confirmation stages are covered.
Synthetic ZDT-style independent fixture values and exact 2D hypervolume oracle pass; final targeted Rust test passed 1 test.
Cargo formatting and public publication checks passed. Cargo scratch debug/deps and debug/incremental directories were removed after the passing test; target tree was 36 MiB.
negative_checks: Modified operator shares fail policy validation; failed refill consumes exactly the bounded attempts without hidden resampling.
Unavailable parent sources return no fallback; unknown/failure/unsupported outcomes do not enter the qualified pool or dominate qualified evidence.
Random-versus-reference comparison is representation-matched and cost-accounted; no assertion requires the optimizer to beat random.
Invalid hypervolume reference points, nonfinite oracle inputs, and nonfinite objective dominance inputs are rejected.
limitations: Verification is software-only and uses synthetic fixtures; it establishes no physical search performance, evaluator validity, or engineering discovery.
The equal-budget controls are tested for contract and accounting behavior; this test is not a multi-seed optimizer benchmark or empirical cost-quality campaign.
next_dependency: Independent scientific admission gates and multi-seed equal-budget algorithm evaluation remain separate.
